subject: Capacity runway & temporary SLA exception for OmniRetail pilot
messages:
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Connor OBrien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 05 Jun 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Capacity runway & temporary SLA exception for OmniRetail pilot

Team —

OmniRetail confirmed a constrained pilot start on Monday (region: us-west). They expect a 6–8 hour ramp window on day one with a peak TPS equivalent to ~1.2M tokens/hour for the first 3 hours, then a tail for the next 72 hours. Attached is their ingress forecast and our initial mapping to request a temporary uplift.

Asks:
- Sales: I need a confirmed quota uplift and temporary rate-limit exception from infra for the pilot window (Mon Jun 7 09:00–18:00 PT).
- Product: are there model variants we should pin to avoid degradation if we increase burst capacity?
- Ops/Infra: fallback plan if we hit saturation (routing to lower-cost model or region) — what's the lead time?

I've attached the forecast and a proposed quota matrix. Karthik — looping you to confirm the client timeline and sign-off if we push for an SLA exception.

Thanks,
David
David Kim
Sr. Account Exec, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: omni_pilot_ingress_forecast.xlsx (xlsx, 38KB)]
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 05 Jun 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Capacity runway & temporary SLA exception for OmniRetail pilot

David / Marissa —

Confirmed on timeline: OmniRetail wants the pilot live Mon 09:00 PT. They will gate their warm-up on a feature toggle, so we should expect a quick spike to validate flows. They asked for a 2x baseline quota bump for 24 hours and then to taper.

I'll own client comms and can provide a signed confirmation this afternoon. If infra can support a temporary uplift, we can move forward.

Karthik
Account Lead

Date: Sun, 06 Jun 2027 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Capacity runway & temporary SLA exception for OmniRetail pilot

Thanks, team. Quick product notes after reviewing the ingress forecast:
- Model pinning: propose we pin to redwood-clarity-3.0-q4 (8-bit quantized) for the pilot. It has predictable latency at the token volumes they listed and degrades gracefully.
- Caching: enable prefix caching for known completions (their homepage widget uses repeated prompts) which should shave ~20% of token traffic during warm-up.
- Telemetry hooks: need a shared prometheus endpoint + trace tags from the client so we can correlate client-side attempts with our token counts.

Connor — can infra enable a temporary per-customer ingress bump scoped to this pilot (not global) and document the rollback trigger? Also adding a small SLA exception for the pilot window to avoid automated throttling if they overshoot.

Attached: proposed_quota_matrix.csv

Marissa
Product Manager, Serving
[Attachment: proposed_quota_matrix.csv (csv, 6KB)]
From: Connor OBrien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 07 Jun 2027 02:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Capacity runway & temporary SLA exception for OmniRetail pilot

Marissa / all —

We can do a scoped, ephemeral uplift for OmniRetail for the requested window. Details:
- Uplift scope: customer-scoped rate and concurrency increase (no change to global tiers).
- Window: Mon Jun 7 09:00–18:00 PT (we'll add a 30-min cushion before/after).
- Limits: +150% on per-minute token rate, +2 concurrent model slots for pinned variant.
- Rollback trigger: sustained 95th percentile CPU/GPU utilization > 88% for 10 minutes OR error rate > 2%.
- Lead time: we need final approval and owner confirmation by EOD Sun Jun 6 to deploy controls and dashboarding.

Two risks to call out: cross-tenant cache eviction leading to higher cold-starts, and autoscaler oscillation if we don't set a sensible cool-down. We'll set conservative scaling thresholds and pre-warm weights.

Connor
Infra Ops
From: Lisa Huang <lisa.huang@omni-retail.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: ops@omni-retail.com
Date: Mon, 07 Jun 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Capacity runway & temporary SLA exception for OmniRetail pilot

David, Karthik —

Thanks for the quick turn. We confirm the pilot ramp and accept the proposed limits. A few asks from our side:
- Can Redwood commit to a 15-minute notification before rollback? We have UX gating that should pause traffic if we hear a rollback.
- Can we get a short-lived read-only dashboard link for the pilot window (token counts, errors, latencies)?

We're good to sign the temporary SLA addendum you shared in the thread if infra confirms the rollback triggers and lead time.

-Lisa
Head of Integrations, OmniRetail
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Connor OBrien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 08 Jun 2027 17:43:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Capacity runway & temporary SLA exception for OmniRetail pilot

All —

We're approved for the scoped uplift. Summary of what infra will enact tomorrow morning:
- Customer-scoped +150% token rate, +2 model slots for redwood-clarity-3.0-q4 from 08:30 PT (pre-warm) through 18:30 PT Mon Jun 7.
- Read-only dashboard will be available at the link below; Ops will push a 15-minute rollback notification to the client's webhook.
- Telemetry tags: Marissa — we need your tracing key by 06:00 PT Mon to wire into the dashboard.

Links: https://ops.redwood.com/dashboards/omni-pilot-readonly; HubSpot: https://hubspot.redwood.com/deals/DEAL-4982

I'll update the rollout playbook and notify legal/finance about the temporary SLA addendum so procurement can sign. Great work moving fast on this.

Neha
Head of Dedicated Capacity Programs, Redwood Inference
